import datetime, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, random, re, statistics, subprocess, time

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/ferroni-perf-unicode-classes')
BASE = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/ferroni-unicode-expanded-baseline')
OUT = pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-refinement-confirmation')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
CRITERION = OUT / 'criterion'
ARTIFACT = OUT / 'artifact.json'
BINS = {'baseline': pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-expanded-baseline.bench'), 'candidate': pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-refined-candidate.bench')}
ENV = dict(os.environ, CRITERION_HOME=str(CRITERION))

def utc():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def capture(args, cwd=ROOT):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, cwd=cwd, text=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).strip()

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

files = ['Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'benches/battle_bench.rs', 'benches/general_regex.rs', 'benches/battle_inputs.toml', 'benches/scanner_documents.rs', 'src/regexec.rs']
data = {
    'format_version': 1, 'question': 'Does direct interval membership eliminate the original PR 177 regressions across the full 41-case matrix?',
    'start_utc': utc(), 'main_commit': '486126c6861a115619ce569cf3bdc333a4ebf0aa',
    'baseline_commit': capture(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], BASE),
    'candidate_commit': capture(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']),
    'source_states': {n: capture(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], p) for n,p in [('baseline',BASE),('candidate',ROOT)]},
    'source_sha256': {n:{f:sha(p/f) for f in files} for n,p in [('baseline',BASE),('candidate',ROOT)]},
    'binary_sha256': {n: sha(p) for n,p in BINS.items()},
    'rustc': capture(['rustc','-vV']), 'os': capture(['sw_vers']),
    'hardware': capture(['sysctl','machdep.cpu.brand_string','hw.memsize','hw.ncpu']),
    'power_state_before': capture(['pmset','-g','therm']),
    'external_inputs': (ROOT/'benches/battle_inputs.toml').read_text(),
    'upstream_source_commit': pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-match-cache/.cache/upstream/oniguruma-orig/.ferroni-upstream-commit').read_text().strip(),
    'build_command': 'FERRONI_ONIGURUMA_DIR=<pinned C checkout> cargo bench --locked --features ffi --bench battle_bench --no-run',
    'sampling': {'samples':30, 'warmup_ms':500, 'measurement_seconds':4, 'features':['ffi'], 'match_cache':False, 'lto':'thin', 'cold_start':False},
    'environment_overrides': {k:os.environ.get(k) for k in ['RUSTFLAGS','CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS','CARGO_PROFILE_BENCH_OPT_LEVEL','CARGO_PROFILE_BENCH_LTO','CARGO_BUILD_TARGET','CFLAGS']},
    'order_policy': 'Per case ABBA or BAAB, alternating by case index; seeded case shuffle 17720260926. No discarded or selectively repeated timing runs.',
    'coordination': 'Exclusive advisory CPU gate held throughout; no other task build/test/benchmark may overlap. Desktop background work remains uncontrolled.',
    'runner_source': pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'validation': [], 'workloads': [], 'measurements': [], 'summaries': []
}

def save():
    ARTIFACT.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')

for name, binary in BINS.items():
    command = [str(binary), '--test']
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=OUT, env=ENV, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=60)
    (OUT/(name+'-smoke.log')).write_text(result.stdout)
    data['validation'].append({'variant':name,'command':command,'exit':result.returncode,'successful_cases':result.stdout.count('\nSuccess')})
    if name=='baseline':
        data['workloads'] = [json.loads(line[9:]) for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('WORKLOAD ')]
        for item in data['workloads']:
            if 'record' in item:
                text = (item['record'] * item['records']).encode()
                item['input_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(text).hexdigest()
                assert len(text)==item['bytes']
    save()
    assert result.returncode==0, result.stdout[-3000:]

listing = capture([str(BINS['candidate']), '--list'], OUT)
selected = []
for line in listing.splitlines():
    if not line.endswith(': benchmark'):
        continue
    name = line.removesuffix(': benchmark')
    if (name.startswith('unicode_classes/rust/') or name.startswith('general_regex/rust/')
        or (name.startswith('scanner_documents/') and name.endswith('_rust'))
        or name in ['single_pattern/rust/unicode_greek','single_pattern/rust/literal_exact','compilation/rust/literal']):
        selected.append(name)
assert len(selected)==41, (len(selected),selected)
random.Random(17720260926).shuffle(selected)
data['selected_cases'] = selected
save()
for index, case in enumerate(selected):
    order = ['baseline','candidate','candidate','baseline'] if index%2==0 else ['candidate','baseline','baseline','candidate']
    counts = {'baseline':0,'candidate':0}
    rows = []
    for variant in order:
        counts[variant] += 1
        label = f'refined-{variant}-{counts[variant]}'
        command = [str(BINS[variant]), '^'+re.escape(case)+'$', '--bench', '--noplot', '--save-baseline', label]
        start = time.monotonic()
        info = {'case':case, 'variant':variant, 'label':label, 'command':command, 'start_utc':utc(), 'load_average':os.getloadavg()}
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=OUT, env=ENV, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=60)
        info.update(exit=result.returncode, elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
        (OUT/f'{index:02d}-{label}.log').write_text(result.stdout)
        if result.returncode!=0:
            data['measurements'].append(info); save(); raise RuntimeError(result.stdout[-3000:])
        path = CRITERION/case/label
        info['estimates'] = json.loads((path/'estimates.json').read_text())
        info['samples'] = json.loads((path/'sample.json').read_text())
        info['benchmark'] = json.loads((path/'benchmark.json').read_text())
        assert len(info['samples']['times'])==30
        data['measurements'].append(info); rows.append(info); save()
    means = {v:[r['estimates']['mean']['point_estimate'] for r in rows if r['variant']==v] for v in counts}
    before = statistics.mean(means['baseline']); after = statistics.mean(means['candidate'])
    summary = {'case':case,'baseline_ns':before,'candidate_ns':after,'time_change_percent':(after/before-1)*100,'run_means_ns':means}
    data['summaries'].append(summary); save()
    print(f"{index+1}/41 {case}: {before/1000:.4f} -> {after/1000:.4f} us ({summary['time_change_percent']:+.2f}%)",flush=True)
data['end_utc']=utc(); data['power_state_after']=capture(['pmset','-g','therm']); save()
print('COMPLETE '+str(ARTIFACT),flush=True)

    before = statistics.mean(means['baseline']); after = statistics.mean(means['candidate'])
    summary = {'case':case,'baseline_ns':before,'candidate_ns':after,'time_change_percent':(after/before-1)*100,'run_means_ns':means}
    data['summaries'].append(summary); save()
    print(f"{index+1}/1 {case}: {before/1000:.4f} -> {after/1000:.4f} us ({summary['time_change_percent']:+.2f}%)",flush=True)
data['end_utc']=utc(); data['power_state_after']=capture(['pmset','-g','therm']); save()
print('COMPLETE '+str(ARTIFACT),flush=True)

import json,pathlib,statistics,math
root=pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/ferroni-perf-unicode-classes')
d=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-refinement-confirmation/artifact.json').read_text())
r=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-refinement-control-recovery/artifact.json').read_text())
g=json.loads((root/'benches/results/unicode-range-lookup-refinement-diagnostic-2026-09-26.json').read_text())
assert len(d['measurements'])==164 and len(r['measurements'])==4 and len(g['measurements'])==48
assert d['candidate_commit']==r['candidate_commit']=='4317cc2e4a37483fc5a5ba1b27464d231db0700a'
assert d['end_utc'] < r['start_utc']
for n in ('baseline','candidate'):
 assert d['binary_sha256'][n]==r['binary_sha256'][n]
 assert d['source_sha256'][n]==r['source_sha256'][n]
for f in d['source_sha256']['baseline']:
 if f!='src/regexec.rs': assert d['source_sha256']['baseline'][f]==d['source_sha256']['candidate'][f]
for row in d['measurements']+r['measurements']+g['measurements']:
 assert len(row['samples']['times'])==30
 m=statistics.mean(t/i for t,i in zip(row['samples']['times'],row['samples']['iters']))
 assert math.isclose(m,row['estimates']['mean']['point_estimate'],rel_tol=1e-12)
case='unicode_classes/rust/letters_ascii_long'
d['coordination']+=' Exception: the Git pre-push hook ran cargo fmt -- --check around 16:43:20 UTC, overlapping the second baseline run of letters_ascii_long. The entire control was repeated afterward; see interference_recovery.'
d['interference_recovery']={'reason':'Known pre-push formatting-hook overlap; not a timing-based rerun. The hook was read and contains only cargo fmt -- --check.', 'affected_original_case':case,'affected_original_label':'refined-baseline-2','original_summary':next(s for s in d['summaries'] if s['case']==case),'replacement':r}
rows=[]
for s in d['summaries']:
 active=r if s['case']==case else d
 summary=next(x for x in active['summaries'] if x['case']==s['case'])
 rs={v:[x for x in active['measurements'] if x['case']==s['case'] and x['variant']==v] for v in ('baseline','candidate')}
 paired=[]; directions=[]
 for b,c in zip(rs['baseline'],rs['candidate']):
  bm=b['estimates']['mean']; cm=c['estimates']['mean']; paired.append((cm['point_estimate']/bm['point_estimate']-1)*100)
  bc=bm['confidence_interval']; cc=cm['confidence_interval']; directions.append('faster' if cc['upper_bound']<bc['lower_bound'] else 'slower' if cc['lower_bound']>bc['upper_bound'] else 'overlap')
 rows.append(dict(summary,measurement_source='interference_recovery' if active is r else 'original_matrix',paired_changes_percent=paired,per_pair_interval_direction=directions))
d['report_analysis']={'confirmation_run_count_including_recovery':168,'confirmation_sample_count_including_recovery':5040,'independently_recomputed_means_including_diagnostic':216,'rows':rows,'source':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()}
out=root/'benches/results/unicode-range-lookup-refined-2026-09-26.json'; out.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
def table(items,short):
 lines=['| Case | Before (µs) | After (µs) | Time change | Pair 1 / Pair 2 |','| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |']
 for s in sorted(items,key=lambda s:s['case']):
  label=s['case'].removeprefix('unicode_classes/rust/') if short else s['case']
  lines.append(f"| `{label}` | {s['baseline_ns']/1000:.3f} | {s['candidate_ns']/1000:.3f} | {s['time_change_percent']:+.1f}% | "+' / '.join(f'{p:+.1f}%' for p in s['paired_changes_percent'])+' |')
 return '\n'.join(lines)
diag=['| Case | Original partition search | Paired lower-bound loop | Direct interval membership |','| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |']
for s in g['summaries']:
 label=s['case'].split('/')[-1]; t=s['time_change_percent']; diag.append(f"| `{label}` | {t['partition']:+.1f}% | {t['paired_loop']:+.1f}% | {t['interval_search']:+.1f}% |")
t=pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-refinement-report-template.mdx').read_text()
t=t.replace('{{DIAGNOSTIC_TABLE}}','\n'.join(diag)).replace('{{UNICODE_TABLE}}',table([s for s in rows if s['case'].startswith('unicode_classes/')],True)).replace('{{CONTROL_TABLE}}',table([s for s in rows if not s['case'].startswith('unicode_classes/')],False))
t=t.replace('{{RESULT_SUMMARY}}',pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-refinement-result-summary.txt').read_text().strip()).replace('{{CONTROL_INTERPRETATION}}',pathlib.Path('/tmp/ferroni-unicode-refinement-control-interpretation.txt').read_text().strip())
assert '{{' not in t
(root/'docs/app/routes/perf/unicode-range-lookup-refinement.mdx').write_text(t)
print('Wrote complete confirmation artifact and report; verified all 216 raw means.')
for s in sorted(rows,key=lambda s:s['time_change_percent'],reverse=True):print(s['case'],round(s['time_change_percent'],3),s['paired_changes_percent'],s['per_pair_interval_direction'])
